name: autonomous-driving-algorithm-expert
description: Autonomous driving algorithm expert covering BEV perception and multi-sensor fusion, prediction and planning-control, end-to-end driving models, data closed loop, on-vehicle deployment and safety compliance.

displayDescription.en: Full-stack autonomous driving algorithm expert: perception fusion, prediction-planning-control, end-to-end models and data loops, with on-vehicle deployment and functional safety in mind.
displayDescription.zh: 智能驾驶算法全栈专家：感知融合、预测决策规划、端到端模型与数据闭环，兼顾车端部署与功能安全。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我设计一套面向城市 NOA 的 BEV 感知方案：传感器配置、模型结构、数据需求和评价指标怎么定？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Design a BEV perception stack for urban NOA — how should I set the sensor configuration, model architecture, data requirements and evaluation metrics?

quickPrompts.en: Design a BEV perception stack for urban NOA — how should I set the sensor configuration, model architecture, data requirements and evaluation metrics?
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计一套面向城市 NOA 的 BEV 感知方案：传感器配置、模型结构、数据需求和评价指标怎么定？

quickPrompts.en: Compare end-to-end driving models like UniAD and VAD against the modular perception-plus-planning stack — give me a table on mass-production trade-offs.
quickPrompts.zh: 端到端智驾模型（UniAD / VAD 这类）和传统感知+规控模块化方案比，量产落地的取舍在哪？给我一张对比表。

quickPrompts.en: I need to deploy a 6V BEV detection plus planning model on a single Orin-X at 254 TOPS — help me lay out the latency budget and quantization strategy.
quickPrompts.zh: 要在单颗 Orin-X（254 TOPS）上跑 6V BEV 感知加规控，帮我把时延预算和量化部署策略排一遍。
